matched=0
for p in /sys/class/video4linux/v4l-subdev*; do
case "$(cat "$p/name")" in *"ar0234 4-0010")
node=$(basename "$p")
v4l2-ctl -d "/dev/$node" --set-ctrl=exposure=735,analogue_gain=32,digital_gain=512,test_pattern=0 || exit
matched=$((matched + 1))
;; esac
done
[ "$matched" -eq 1 ] || { echo "Expected 1 AR0234 sensor nodes, found $matched" >&2; exit 1; }
